This constant is defined in `src/backend/commands/progress.h`. The CREATE INDEX progress-reporting "command" values are string macros (surfaced as the `command` column of `pg_stat_progress_create_index`), not integer phase codes: `PROGRESS_CREATEIDX_COMMAND_CREATE` = `"CREATE INDEX"`, `PROGRESS_CREATEIDX_COMMAND_REINDEX` = `"REINDEX"`, and the concurrently variant is the literal string `"REINDEX CONCURRENTLY"`.

ANSWER: "REINDEX CONCURRENTLY"
